responsibility: Computes and applies isl-based schedule optimization for a Graphite SCoP. It gathers the union domain of all polyhedral statements, derives legality constraints from the scop’s dependence relation, sets isl scheduling options, asks isl to compute a transformed schedule, and then optionally postprocesses band nodes for simple tiling using the loop-block tile size parameter. It is the schedule-optimization stage between polyhedral SCoP construction and code regeneration, also handling identity scheduling cases and timeout/error diagnostics when no profitable or legal new schedule is obtained.
